searchText: What does EIP-7702 do with storage that got changed in authorized account? Is assumption to drop it? is this the spec test version we should target for the pectra-devnet-1? Those are EOF tests No, all the OP codes are supposed to work the same as with normal contracts. This includes `SSTORE` and `SELFDESTRUCT`: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/master/EIPS/eip-7702.md#lack-of-instruction-prohibition I'm not familliar enough with the exec-spec tests yet, but if eof is on top of pectra - wouldn't both tests be in the same release? That is okay, but what about state clear? Different suits/folders and there is no overlap. So these tests touch only EOF part even if other prague EIPs are enabled. AFAIK there is no state clear. If during the tx we write to the storage of the EOA account, we persist it. So EOAs can have non-empty storage after 7702 Oh, this is not the greatest solution That’s correct, at the moment they are on top of Cancun but might change when clients decide to do so and we have an EVM tool that can fill them 👍
